mapper.select: SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID, R.START_DATE, R.RETURN_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS, R.GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE, R.OVERDUE_FEE AS overdueFee, (SELECT MAX(O.CREATED_AT) FROM RENTAL_OVERDUE_ORDER O WHERE O.RENTAL_ID = R.RENTAL_ID AND O.STATUS = 'PAID') AS overduePaidAt, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE AS pricePerDay, DATEDIFF(R.RETURN_DATE, R.START_DATE) AS rentalDays, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID -- ★ 추가 WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND O.ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') -- ★ 추가 AND R.RENTAL_STATUS NOT IN ('CANCELLED') -- ★ 추가 ORDER BY R.RENTAL_ID DESC

SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID, R.START_DATE, R.RETURN_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS, R.GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE, R.RETURN_ZIPCODE, R.OVERDUE_FEE AS overdueFee, (SELECT MAX(O.CREATED_AT) FROM RENTAL_OVERDUE_ORDER O WHERE O.RENTAL_ID = R.RENTAL_ID AND O.STATUS = 'PAID') AS overduePaidAt, R.RETURN_ADDRESS, R.RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS, R.RETURN_REQUESTED_AT, DATEDIFF(R.RETURN_DATE, R.START_DATE) AS rentalDays, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE AS pricePerDay, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND R.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID, R.START_DATE, R.RETURN_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS, R.GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE, R.RETURN_ZIPCODE, R.RETURN_ADDRESS, R.RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS, R.RETURN_REQUESTED_AT, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE AS pricePerDay, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND R.GUEST_NAME = #{guestName} AND R.GUEST_PHONE = #{guestPhone} AND R.USER_ID LIKE 'GUEST%' -- 'GUEST' → LIKE 'GUEST%'

SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID, R.START_DATE, R.RETURN_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS, R.GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE, R.RETURN_ZIPCODE, R.RETURN_ADDRESS, R.RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS, R.RETURN_REQUESTED_AT, R.OVERDUE_FEE AS overdueFee, (SELECT MAX(O.CREATED_AT) FROM RENTAL_OVERDUE_ORDER O WHERE O.RENTAL_ID = R.RENTAL_ID AND O.STATUS = 'PAID') AS overduePaidAt, DATEDIFF(R.RETURN_DATE, R.START_DATE) AS rentalDays, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE AS pricePerDay, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId}
SELECT EXTENSION_ID, EXTENSION_DAYS, PRICE, CREATED_AT, RENTAL_ID FROM RENTAL_EXTENSION WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT RENTAL_STATUS AS returnStatus, RETURN_ZIPCODE AS zipcode, RETURN_ADDRESS AS address, RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress, DATE_FORMAT(RETURN_REQUESTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM RENTALS WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND RETURN_REQUESTED_AT IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RENTAL_EXTENSION (EXTENSION_DAYS, PRICE, CREATED_AT, RENTAL_ID) VALUES (#{extensionDays}, #{price}, NOW(), #{rentalId})
mapper.select: SELECT R.RENTAL_ID AS rentalId, R.ITEM_ID AS itemId, R.USER_ID AS userId, R.START_DATE AS startDate, R.RETURN_DATE AS returnDate, R.RENTAL_STATUS AS rentalStatus, R.GUEST_NAME AS guestName, R.GUEST_PHONE AS guestPhone, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS pricePerDay, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.RENTAL_STATUS IN ('IN_USE', 'RESERVED') ORDER BY R.RENTAL_ID DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE RENTALS SET RENTAL_STATUS = 'RETURN_REQUESTED', RETURN_ZIPCODE = #{zipcode}, RETURN_ADDRESS = #{address}, RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS = #{detailedAddress}, RETURN_REQUESTED_AT = NOW() WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND RENTAL_STATUS = 'IN_USE'

UPDATE RENTALS SET RENTAL_STATUS = 'RETURN_REQUESTED', RETURN_ZIPCODE = #{zipcode}, RETURN_ADDRESS = #{address}, RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS = #{detailedAddress}, RETURN_REQUESTED_AT = NOW() WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND GUEST_NAME = #{guestName} AND GUEST_PHONE = #{guestPhone} AND USER_ID LIKE 'GUEST%' AND RENTAL_STATUS = 'IN_USE'
UPDATE DELIVERY SET DELIVERY_STATUS = 'RETURN_REQUESTED' WHERE ORDER_ID = ( SELECT OI.ORDER_ID FROM RENTALS R JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} LIMIT 1 )

UPDATE RENTALS SET RENTAL_STATUS = 'IN_USE', RETURN_ZIPCODE = NULL, RETURN_ADDRESS = NULL, RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS = NULL, RETURN_REQUESTED_AT = NULL WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND RENTAL_STATUS = 'RETURN_REQUESTED'

UPDATE RENTALS SET RENTAL_STATUS = 'IN_USE', RETURN_ZIPCODE = NULL, RETURN_ADDRESS = NULL, RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS = NULL, RETURN_REQUESTED_AT = NULL WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND GUEST_NAME = #{guestName} AND GUEST_PHONE = #{guestPhone} AND USER_ID LIKE 'GUEST%' AND RENTAL_STATUS = 'RETURN_REQUESTED'
UPDATE DELIVERY SET DELIVERY_STATUS = 'DONE' WHERE ORDER_ID = ( SELECT OI.ORDER_ID FROM RENTALS R JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT UA.ZIPCODE AS zipcode, UA.ADDRESS AS address, UA.DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress FROM USER_ADDRESS UA WHERE UA.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY UA.DEFAULT_YN DESC, UA.ADDRESS_ID ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT D.ZIPCODE AS zipcode, D.ADDRESS AS address, D.DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress FROM DELIVERY D JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON D.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID JOIN RENTALS R ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RENTAL_EXTENSION_ORDER (RENTAL_ID, EXTENSION_DAYS, PRICE, STATUS, USER_ID, GUEST_TOKEN, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{rentalId}, #{extensionDays}, #{price}, 'PENDING', #{userId}, #{guestToken}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT eo.EXTENSION_ORDER_ID, eo.RENTAL_ID, eo.EXTENSION_DAYS, eo.PRICE, eo.STATUS, eo.USER_ID, eo.GUEST_TOKEN,
p.PRODUCT_NAME, ( SELECT pi.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG pi WHERE pi.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID AND pi.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ) AS IMG_URL
FROM RENTAL_EXTENSION_ORDER eo JOIN RENTALS r ON eo.RENTAL_ID = r.RENTAL_ID JOIN ORDER_ITEM oi ON r.ITEM_ID = oi.ITEM_ID JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID
WHERE eo.EXTENSION_ORDER_ID = #{extensionOrderId}

SELECT R.RENTAL_ID AS rentalId, R.ITEM_ID AS itemId, R.USER_ID AS userId, R.RENTAL_STATUS AS rentalStatus, R.START_DATE AS startDate, R.RETURN_DATE AS returnDate, R.GUEST_NAME AS guestName, R.GUEST_PHONE AS guestPhone, R.RETURN_ZIPCODE AS returnZipcode, R.RETURN_ADDRESS AS returnAddress, R.RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS AS returnDetailedAddress, DATEDIFF(R.RETURN_DATE, R.START_DATE) AS rentalDays, R.OVERDUE_FEE AS overdueFee, (SELECT MAX(O.CREATED_AT) FROM RENTAL_OVERDUE_ORDER O WHERE O.RENTAL_ID = R.RENTAL_ID AND O.STATUS = 'PAID') AS overduePaidAt, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS pricePerDay, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl FROM RENTALS R JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID -- ★ 추가 WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND O.ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') -- ★ 추가 AND R.RENTAL_STATUS NOT IN ('CANCELLED') -- ★ 추가
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RENTAL_OVERDUE_ORDER (RENTAL_ID, OVERDUE_DAYS, OVERDUE_FEE, STATUS, USER_ID, GUEST_TOKEN, RETURN_ZIPCODE, RETURN_ADDRESS, RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{rentalId}, #{overdueDays}, #{overdueFee}, 'PENDING', #{userId}, #{token}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{detailedAddress}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE RENTALS SET RENTAL_STATUS = 'RETURN_REQUESTED', RETURN_ZIPCODE = #{RETURN_ZIPCODE}, RETURN_ADDRESS = #{RETURN_ADDRESS}, RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS = #{RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS}, RETURN_REQUESTED_AT = NOW(), OVERDUE_FEE = #{OVERDUE_FEE} WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{RENTAL_ID}
mapper.select: SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.USER_ID, R.GUEST_NAME, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_STATUS = 'IN_USE' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), R.RETURN_DATE) = #{days} AND R.OVERDUE_NOTIFY_STAGE < #{days}
